reserveReview.rationale: The tracked asset is legacy ICON bnUSD(old) v1. The historical SODAX Sonic borrower collateral census and pool custody review describe the distinct new bnUSD v2 token, not this liability. Those v2 weights, upstream dependency links and custody claims remain excluded from the legacy curated fallback. The 2026-10-09 review of the issuer transition, withdrawal and migration documentation confirms that legacy loans require bnUSD(old), whereas the migration delivers a distinct new bnUSD at a stated 1:1 rate. These disclosures provide no complete dated legacy Stability Fund, collateral, issuance and bridge backing denominator. The unclassified residual records unresolved attributable composition, not measured zero backing. No historical composition date, v2 allocation or holder capacity is refreshed.
